firstLines: I am applying for the Analytics Lead role advertised on your careers page. I have spent six years in data
roles in retail and energy, and for the last three I have led pricing and customer analytics at Northgate
At Northgate I built the promotion uplift model that now plans every seasonal campaign, and I redesigned
how we target loyalty vouchers. We found that almost a fifth of vouchers were going to customers who
would have bought anyway. Changing that saves the business about £400,000 a year.
I also care about how a team works. I introduced code review and a shared SQL library, and new
analysts now deliver their first report in half the time. I would like to bring that mix of hands-on analysis
and team building to your growing analytics function.
Thank you for considering my application. I would be happy to discuss the role at your convenience.
